verify.summary: Root independently verified FT-003-AC-021: 15 ASGI tests, geometry boundary probe, mypy and lint; two fresh Luna co-reviews found no material defects.
Independent Reviewer inspected normative contracts and actual diff; synthetic header/compatibility probes and two fresh Luna xhigh focuses found no material defects. Lifecycle remains with root.

User-authorized audit finding 1 completed; root reviewed corrected diff and independently reproduced functional proof, then accepted separate T3 semantic-pass. No deployment or production acceptance remains in this card.

title: Guard realtime JPEG decoding behind authentication and header bounds
purpose: Correct audit finding 1: prevent unauthorized or geometry-invalid realtime crops from allocating decoded image arrays.
success_outcome: The existing endpoint authenticates and rate-limits before crop processing, rejects oversized JPEG headers before decode, and preserves valid bounded admission and standard failure responses.
anti_goals: Do not change authentication internals, allowed credentials, request/response fields, body limit, geometry limit or metadata policy.
Do not perform finding 2 threadpool work, Buffalo changes, EXIF inventory changes, edge deployment or other audit fixes.
Do not add a bespoke JPEG parser, pixel/manifest/per-crop-byte limits, download models or alter operator data.

forbidden_scope: Client, deployment, migrations and processing/model implementation
Runtime concurrency and singleton/result orchestration changes owned by TASK-113
stop_conditions: A correct fix requires changing accepted public limits or compatibility instead of enforcing them.
Header inspection cannot reliably reject oversized inputs before full decoding, or changes require paths outside the hard boundary.

constraints: Owner is promo (src/face_moment/promo/); entrypoints/realtime.py only adapts HTTP and calls the existing serving_control auth and promo boundaries; no foreign-state writes.

Keep readiness check and bounded body reading first; then existing Session/auth/rate check, then multipart/JPEG validation before core Attempt creation. Preserve 413 for an oversized body, 401 for bounded invalid-credential requests, 429 for rate rejection and 422 for authenticated invalid payloads.

Promote the already locked Pillow 12.3.0 to a direct dependency without broad lock upgrades. Open BytesIO with Image.open(..., formats=["JPEG"]), inspect only size without load/convert, reject dimensions outside 1..512, and only then run existing OpenCV decode and final shape validation. Convert malformed-header/unsupported-format/decompression-bomb exceptions to RealtimePayloadError; retain metadata rejection.

Use existing disposable PostgreSQL fixture in tests/promo/test_realtime_attempt_api.py, not a default/operator database; generate synthetic JPEGs and no personal media. Review fixture teardown and run via .env.local.

Execution obtains honest RED before production edits; the audit probe is source evidence, not a substituted current execution result. Run verify and per-task red-verify before the explicit owner closes this T3 task.
invariants: Rejected auth/rate/geometry requests invoke no full crop decode and create no Attempt.
No body field supplies spa_id or credentials; auth remains authoritative.
Total body remains 20,971,520 bytes, zero to twenty crops, positive dimensions no side above 512; no new payload limit or domain outcome.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-021 / REQ-SEC-001 and REQ-CAP-002: real ASGI multipart requests with spy on OpenCV decode; prove zero calls for missing/invalid token and exhausted deterministic limiter, and zero calls for authenticated 4096x4096 JPEG under the body cap. Inspect zero persisted Attempts for all rejections.

FT-003-AC-021: malformed/truncated JPEG headers and a non-JPEG disguised as image/jpeg return 422 without full decode; malformed entropy with a bounded valid header fails existing decoding validation. A valid 512x512 control reaches decode and ordinary admission.
Run existing exact body-boundary, metadata, zero-proposal, idempotency and standard-status tests as regression only; do not inherit original AC-006 or TASK-057 acceptance proof.
Retain synthetic-input sizes, returned status, decode call counts and Attempt counts; fixture-owned database teardown proves safe rerun. No OOM/stress attack or production probe is required.
evidence_required: FT-003-AC-021 RED: current bounded unauthorized 4096x4096 JPEG reaches OpenCV decoding and authenticated oversized geometry is checked after allocation; GREEN: identical cases and rate rejection call no decoder, invalid payloads create no Attempt, while a valid 512x512 JPEG reaches ordinary admission; decisive comparison: HTTP statuses, decode-call trace and persisted Attempt count for the controlled input matrix; artifact: focused regression transcript under .tasks/TASK-112-T3-FT-003-W4/.
